review: Read the complete bridge, isolated PCM relay, media boundary, existing four tests and new three-test startup cancellation suite. First-party browser transport and synthetic test fixtures; no third-party implementation, assets, live identity, credentials or audio exported.

Bridge requires an existing GPT Live media boundary and laptop mic off, parses a room-scoped ticket, verifies plausible expiry and exact isolated-session fields, and bounds WebSocket frames and queues. Start/stop uses explicit owner controls; it starts no model session itself.

Owner stop is checked before startup, after audio resume and ticket issuance and after approved-ticket callbacks. Late tickets cannot construct a socket. The new regression suite reproduced all three startup cancellation failures before the fix.

The isolated relay binds room, invitation, worker, Realtime session, provider call and speaker metadata into a segment hash; bounds PCM size/chunks/transfer time; checks offset, payload digest and segment digest before its callback; clears PCM on completion and invalidates in-flight digest callbacks on clear.

Isolated metadata and retained allowance IDs are observations, not authority. Native consumer/server admission still recheck current funding, consent, room and speaker permissions. No paid provider or Discord connection was exercised.

The unchanged media boundary is an ephemeral map over existing transport controllers. Its controller import is type-only. Source preview omits the full controller/runtime and shared-contract deployment.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal only; not committed or published.
The two authored cancellation files are newer than running R380. Existing helper changes predate this fix; no installed bridge acceptance claimed.

Seven focused mocked tests cover startup cancellation, safe close messages and isolated ticket scope; they do not cover complete audio relay integrity, live Discord consent/funding, transcript attribution or Minecraft/GPT Live continuity.
Cancelling locally does not revoke a ticket already issued server-side or undo an admitted provider operation.
Relay clear/reuse concurrency and the complete media restoration lifecycle have not been independently qualified by this cohort.
